svg.title: Alpha-carbon trace of a predicted NADH oxidase dimer with NAD and FAD
svg.desc: Transparent coordinate-derived orthographic projection of dimer0057_nadh_fad.cif. Chain A in teal and chain B in blue, each with 205 alpha-carbon positions. Gold marks the heavy-atom coordinates of two FAD and two NAD molecules; proximity-based sticks omit bond order. This is a predicted structure, not an experimental determination.
